title: Toilet flush
prompt: how does a toilet flush? a toilet with a cistern: press the flush, water rushes down, the cistern refills and stops itself; see-through shows the flush valve, siphon, float, fill valve and overflow tube
blurb: Press the handle and watch the flapper lift, the bowl siphon itself empty with a glug, and the float ride back up until it shuts the fill valve.
